blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Melatonin is a natural sleep aid that the brain produces in response to darkness. Zahler® Junior Melatonin provides children with 1 mg of sleep-regulating melatonin to help support restful & quality sleep.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 chewable tablet at bedtime or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Sorbitol, microcrystalline cellulose, stearic acid, citric acid, silicon dioxide, natural flavor, fruit and vegetable juice powder (color), rebaudioside-a (from stevia leaf extract).
Made in the USA with globally sourced ingredients.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. For use only at bedtime. Not intended for children under 5 years old. If your child is taking medication or has a medical condition, consult a physician before using this product. This product is not to be taken by pregnant or lactating women. Do not use in conjunction with alcoholic beverages, when driving a vehicle, or while operating machinery.
Store tightly closed in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight.
